quests.instruction: Which small airplane flies low over farm fields to spray crops?
quests.question: Crop Duster
quests.hint: Think about a small plane swooping low right above a farmer's field, spraying a fine mist.
quests.explanation: A crop duster is a small airplane that sprays farm fields. Crop dusters fly low over crops to help them grow!
quests.funFact: A skilled crop duster pilot flies extremely close to the ground, sometimes just a few feet above the crops!

quests.instruction: Which helicopter rushes urgently to bring hurt or sick people to the hospital fast?
quests.question: Air Ambulance
quests.hint: Think about a helicopter with a medical cross painted on it, rushing someone to the hospital quickly.
quests.explanation: An air ambulance is a helicopter that rushes people to the hospital. Air ambulances travel quickly over traffic!
quests.funFact: An air ambulance can reach a hospital far faster than a regular ambulance stuck in traffic!

quests.instruction: Which flying robot delivers small packages without any pilot on board?
quests.question: Cargo Drone
quests.hint: Think about a small flying robot buzzing overhead, carrying a tiny package to someone's doorstep.
quests.explanation: A cargo drone is a flying robot that delivers packages. Cargo drones fly automatically with no pilot inside!
quests.funFact: Cargo drones are being tested to deliver small packages, like medicine, extremely quickly!

quests.instruction: Which boat rises up on thin underwater fins so it can skim above the water at high speed?
quests.question: Hydrofoil
quests.hint: Think about a boat that lifts itself up out of the water on thin fins, gliding above the waves at high speed.
quests.explanation: A hydrofoil is a boat that rises above the water on fins. Hydrofoils skim the surface at very high speed!
quests.funFact: Lifting out of the water helps a hydrofoil travel much faster than a regular boat!

quests.instruction: Which small submarine carries scientists deep underwater to study ocean life?
quests.question: Research Submarine
quests.hint: Think about a small submarine carrying scientists deep down to study strange creatures near the ocean floor.
quests.explanation: A research submarine carries scientists deep underwater. Research submarines help study ocean life and the sea floor!
quests.funFact: A research submarine can dive deeper than almost any other kind of vehicle on Earth!

quests.instruction: Which official manages all the ships coming and going at a busy port?
quests.question: Harbor Master
quests.hint: Think about the official at a port who decides exactly when each ship can safely enter or leave.
quests.explanation: A harbor master is an official who manages ships at a port. Harbor masters keep a busy harbor running safely!
quests.funFact: A harbor master helps make sure that many ships can enter and leave a busy port without any accidents!

quests.instruction: Which crew member keeps a ship's engines and machines running smoothly?
quests.question: Ship's Engineer
quests.hint: Think about the crew member working belowdecks, keeping a ship's big engines running smoothly.
quests.explanation: A ship's engineer keeps a ship's engines running. Ship's engineers work belowdecks to fix and maintain machines!
quests.funFact: A ship's engineer must understand every single machine that keeps a huge ship moving safely!

quests.instruction: Which orbiting home lets astronauts live and work together far above the Earth?
quests.question: Space Station
quests.hint: Think about a large structure orbiting high above the Earth, where astronauts live and do experiments together.
quests.explanation: A space station is an orbiting home for astronauts. Astronauts live and work together aboard a space station!
quests.funFact: Astronauts aboard a space station can see a sunrise and sunset many times every single day!

quests.instruction: Which small spacecraft carries astronauts safely to and from space?
quests.question: Space Capsule
quests.hint: Think about a small, rounded spacecraft that carries astronauts safely up to space and back to Earth.
quests.explanation: A space capsule is a small spacecraft for astronauts. Space capsules carry astronauts safely to and from space!
quests.funFact: A space capsule is specially shaped to survive the intense heat of returning to Earth!

quests.instruction: Which small spacecraft was built to carry astronauts down onto the surface of the Moon?
quests.question: Lunar Module
quests.hint: Think about a small, spindly spacecraft that once carried astronauts gently down onto the Moon's dusty surface.
quests.explanation: A lunar module is a spacecraft for landing on the Moon. Lunar modules once carried astronauts safely to the Moon's surface!
quests.funFact: The very first lunar module safely carried astronauts to walk on the Moon for the first time in history!

quests.instruction: Which special suit protects an astronaut while working outside a spacecraft?
quests.question: Space Suit
quests.hint: Think about the bulky white suit an astronaut wears to stay safe while floating outside their spacecraft.
quests.explanation: A space suit is a special suit protecting an astronaut. Astronauts wear a space suit outside their spacecraft!
quests.funFact: A space suit gives an astronaut air to breathe and keeps them warm in the freezing cold of space!

quests.instruction: Which platform holds a rocket steady before it blasts off into space?
quests.question: Launch Pad
quests.hint: Think about the sturdy platform where a rocket stands tall, waiting for the countdown before liftoff.
quests.explanation: A launch pad is a platform that holds a rocket steady. Rockets blast off from a launch pad into space!
quests.funFact: A launch pad must be built extremely strong to survive the powerful blast of a rocket taking off!

quests.instruction: Which room full of computers and workers guides a spacecraft during its whole journey?
quests.question: Mission Control
quests.hint: Think about the busy room full of screens and workers on the ground, guiding astronauts through their whole mission.
quests.explanation: Mission control is a room that guides a spacecraft's journey. Workers at mission control track every step of a mission!
quests.funFact: Workers at mission control watch every detail closely to help keep astronauts safe during their whole journey!

quests.instruction: Which powerful extra rocket helps push a spacecraft off the ground before falling away?
quests.question: Booster Rocket
quests.hint: Think about the extra, powerful rocket attached to the side of a spacecraft, giving it a strong push before falling away.
quests.explanation: A booster rocket is an extra rocket that helps a launch. Booster rockets give a powerful push before falling away!
quests.funFact: Some booster rockets are designed to be caught and reused for a future launch!

quests.instruction: Which type of car can drive itself using cameras and computers, without a person steering?
quests.question: Self-Driving Car
quests.hint: Think about a car with cameras and computers that can steer, brake, and drive all by itself.
quests.explanation: A self-driving car drives itself using cameras and computers. Self-driving cars are a very modern kind of technology!
quests.funFact: Self-driving cars use many cameras and sensors to safely watch the road all around them!

quests.instruction: Which futuristic vehicle can drive on roads and also lift up to fly through the air?
quests.question: Flying Car
quests.hint: Think about a car that can drive down the street and then lift straight up into the sky to fly.
quests.explanation: A flying car can drive on roads and also fly. Flying cars are an exciting, futuristic kind of vehicle!
quests.funFact: Inventors and engineers are working hard today to build flying cars that could one day be common!

quests.instruction: Which futuristic transport system shoots pods through a tube at extremely high speed?
quests.question: Hyperloop
quests.hint: Think about a futuristic tube system that shoots a pod full of passengers at incredibly high speed.
quests.explanation: A hyperloop shoots pods through a tube at high speed. Hyperloops are a futuristic idea for super-fast travel!
quests.funFact: A hyperloop pod could one day travel almost as fast as an airplane, but much closer to the ground!

quests.instruction: Which type of car is powered by sunlight collected through panels on its surface?
quests.question: Solar Car
quests.hint: Think about a car covered in flat panels that soak up sunlight to power its engine.
quests.explanation: A solar car is powered by sunlight through panels. Solar cars use the sun's energy instead of gasoline!
quests.funFact: Solar-powered race cars compete in special races that stretch across entire sunny countries!

quests.instruction: Which type of train runs on electric power instead of burning coal or diesel fuel?
quests.question: Electric Train
quests.hint: Think about a modern train powered by electricity from overhead wires or a special rail, instead of burning fuel.
quests.explanation: An electric train runs on electric power. Electric trains are a clean, modern alternative to older trains!
quests.funFact: Electric trains produce much less pollution than older trains that burn coal or diesel fuel!

quests.instruction: Which roadside stop checks that a truck's cargo is not too heavy for the road?
quests.question: Weigh Station
quests.hint: Think about the roadside stop where big trucks pull over to have their heavy cargo weighed.
quests.explanation: A weigh station checks a truck's cargo weight. Weigh stations help make sure trucks are not too heavy for the road!
quests.funFact: A weigh station's big scale can weigh an entire truck in just a few short seconds!

quests.instruction: Which rest stop along a highway offers food, fuel, and restrooms for tired travelers?
quests.question: Service Area
quests.hint: Think about the rest stop along a highway with a restaurant, gas pumps, and restrooms for travelers.
quests.explanation: A service area is a highway rest stop with food and fuel. Travelers stop at a service area to rest and refuel!
quests.funFact: A busy service area can serve hundreds of hungry, tired travelers every single day!

quests.instruction: Which tall building at an airport lets workers watch and guide every plane on the ground and in the sky?
quests.question: Control Tower
quests.hint: Think about the tall tower at an airport with big windows, letting workers watch and guide every single plane.
quests.explanation: A control tower is a tall building for guiding planes. Workers in the control tower guide planes on the ground and in the sky!
quests.funFact: A control tower's height lets workers see the entire airport and every runway clearly!

quests.instruction: Which behind-the-scenes machine sorts every suitcase to the correct flight at an airport?
quests.question: Baggage Sorter
quests.hint: Think about the hidden machine behind the airport walls, sorting each suitcase onto the correct plane.
quests.explanation: A baggage sorter is a machine that sorts suitcases. Baggage sorters make sure each bag reaches the right flight!
quests.funFact: A busy airport's baggage sorter can sort thousands of suitcases correctly every single day!

quests.instruction: Which moving belt carries suitcases around so passengers can pick up their own bag?
quests.question: Conveyor Belt
quests.hint: Think about the moving belt at baggage claim that circles around, carrying suitcases past waiting travelers.
quests.explanation: A conveyor belt is a moving belt carrying suitcases. Travelers watch the conveyor belt to spot their own bag!
quests.funFact: A conveyor belt moves at just the right speed so travelers have time to spot and grab their bag!

quests.instruction: Which machine lets a pilot practice flying without ever actually leaving the ground?
quests.question: Flight Simulator
quests.hint: Think about a machine that looks just like a real cockpit, letting a pilot practice flying safely on the ground.
quests.explanation: A flight simulator lets pilots practice without leaving the ground. Flight simulators feel just like flying a real plane!
quests.funFact: Pilots use a flight simulator to safely practice for emergencies they hope never really happen!

quests.instruction: Which cone-shaped fabric tube at an airport shows the wind's direction and strength?
quests.question: Windsock
quests.hint: Think about the striped fabric cone at an airport that fills with wind and points to show its direction.
quests.explanation: A windsock is a fabric tube showing wind direction. Pilots check the windsock before taking off or landing!
quests.funFact: A windsock fills up and stands out straight when the wind is blowing especially strong!

quests.instruction: Which covered walkway connects the terminal directly to the airplane's door?
quests.question: Boarding Bridge
quests.hint: Think about the long, covered tunnel that connects the airport building right up to the airplane's door.
quests.explanation: A boarding bridge is a covered walkway to the plane. Passengers walk through a boarding bridge to reach their seats!
quests.funFact: A boarding bridge can extend or shrink to connect perfectly with many different sizes of airplane!

quests.instruction: Which giant metal box holds goods so they can be easily moved between ships, trucks, and trains?
quests.question: Cargo Container
quests.hint: Think about the giant metal box, all the same size, stacked on ships and loaded straight onto trucks.
quests.explanation: A cargo container is a giant metal box for goods. Cargo containers move easily between ships, trucks, and trains!
quests.funFact: Every cargo container is built to the exact same size, so they stack together perfectly!

quests.instruction: Which busy area stores and organizes thousands of cargo containers near a port?
quests.question: Shipping Yard
quests.hint: Think about the busy area near a port, stacked high with thousands of colorful cargo containers.
quests.explanation: A shipping yard is an area for storing cargo containers. Shipping yards organize containers near a busy port!
quests.funFact: A big shipping yard can store thousands of containers, all waiting for their next ship or truck!

quests.instruction: Which powerful engine car pulls all the other cars of a train along the tracks?
quests.question: Locomotive
quests.hint: Think about the powerful engine at the very front of a train, pulling every other car behind it.
quests.explanation: A locomotive is the powerful engine that pulls a train. A locomotive gives a whole train the power to move!
quests.funFact: A single powerful locomotive can pull dozens of heavy train cars all at the same time!
